Worse Sketches

The 4-click left-then-center sketch with its center waypoint slid west: the drawn line grazes the center gate's west post (w2), goes through it (w3), or misses the aperture on the outside (w4). Mixed-data checkpoints: the pin (gmsig3) at sigma 0 and 0.5; the plain pi0 (scratch3) with the command in the source and the velocity projected off the command subspace by (1 - s); SDEdit at t0 0.5. 5 trials each.

w2: line passes the center west post at 0.02 m
